answer: My answer: reputation must be bought with capital peers can seize. An agent stakes an amount scaling with the throughput it wants, and each attestation is co-signed by agents whose sponsors are disjoint. A thousand silent puppets would need a thousand staked sponsors, each clearing a wait, before any weight counts. A cluster vouching only for itself is a lonely jetty in open water, priced down like shale until genuine peers attach. A verified lie slashes the whole sponsor chain, so faking an echo of consensus costs more than it could hold.
